elements.name: Archery
elements.desc: +2 bonus to attack rolls with ranged weapons.

elements.name: Defense
elements.desc: +1 AC while wearing armor.

elements.name: Dueling
elements.desc: +2 damage with a one-handed melee weapon and no other weapon.

elements.name: Protection
elements.desc: Use your reaction to impose disadvantage on an attack against an adjacent ally (needs a shield).

elements.name: Spellcasting
elements.desc: You cast wizard spells from your spellbook using Intelligence.

elements.name: Cleric Spellcasting
elements.desc: You cast cleric spells using Wisdom. Spell save DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + Wisdom modifier. You prepare Wisdom modifier + cleric level spells.

elements.name: Channel Divinity
elements.desc: Channel divine energy for Turn Undead and a domain effect. You regain uses on a short or long rest (1 use; 2 at level 6; 3 at level 18).

elements.name: Destroy Undead
elements.desc: When an undead fails its save against Turn Undead, it is destroyed if its challenge rating is at or below a threshold (1/2 at level 5, rising to 4 at level 17).

elements.name: Divine Intervention
elements.desc: At 10th level, use your action to call on your deity: roll percentile dice, and if you roll your cleric level or lower, your deity intervenes. At 20th level it succeeds automatically.

elements.name: Bonus Proficiency
elements.desc: When you choose this domain at 1st level, you gain proficiency with heavy armor.

elements.name: Disciple of Life
elements.desc: Your healing spells are more effective. Whenever you use a spell of 1st level or higher to restore hit points to a creature, the creature regains additional hit points equal to 2 + the spell’s level.

elements.name: Channel Divinity: Preserve Life
elements.desc: As an action, restore a number of hit points equal to five times your cleric level, divided among creatures within 30 feet. A creature can be restored to no more than half its hit point maximum. Not usable on undead or constructs.

elements.name: Blessed Healer
elements.desc: The healing spells you cast on others heal you as well. When you cast a spell of 1st level or higher that restores hit points to a creature other than you, you regain 2 + the spell’s level hit points.

elements.name: Divine Strike
elements.desc: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can deal an extra 1d8 radiant damage (2d8 at 14th level).

elements.name: Supreme Healing
elements.desc: When you would normally roll dice to restore hit points with a spell, you instead use the highest number possible for each die.

elements.name: Cleric
elements.desc: Hit die d8. Saves: Wisdom, Charisma. Skills: choose two from History, Insight, Medicine, Persuasion, Religion.
